answer.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS win_count
FROM results AS m
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = m.driverId
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = m.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId
WHERE d.forename = 'Michael'
  AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'
  AND c.name = 'Sepang International Circuit'
  AND m.points = (
      SELECT MAX(r.points)
      FROM results AS r
      WHERE r.raceId = m.raceId
  );
